options.title: Rajasthan vs Germany: kaun bada? 🏜️
options.first_frame: Rajasthan lifted off India's map in sand colour, with Germany's outline filled with its black-red-gold flag sliding in beside it at the same scale.

options.first_line: क्या पूरा फ़िनलैंड राजस्थान में समा जाएगा?
options.first_frame: Finland's outline in its blue-cross flag hanging over Rajasthan on India's map, about to drop onto it.

options.title: Bharat ka sabse bada state Europe ke aage kitna bada? 🗺️
options.first_line: भारत का सबसे बड़ा स्टेट, यूरोप के देशों के आगे कितना बड़ा है?
options.first_frame: Rajasthan glowing on India's map with three small European flags lined up beside it.

why: Germany is a country every viewer can picture and the side-by-side outlines at the same scale pose a real "which is bigger?" question without sound that you must stay to see answered, while B names a less familiar country and C is vague about what is being compared.
